description: Takes one picture off a project in your own company: it no longer shows anywhere on the project, and stays on record (restore true brings it back). Works on the project's own pictures and its items' pictures (ids from project). Owner only. Needs the owner's sign-in.

picture_id.description: Picture id, from project: pictures or removed_pictures

restore.description: true: bring a removed picture back

name: remove_project_picture
title: Remove a project picture
